status: frozen before any table-of-contents screen or report reading; SHA-256 and UTC time are recorded in README.md
purpose: Systematic list of recorded features near the project's places from Hadashot Arkheologiyot - Excavations and Surveys in Israel (HA, ESI, HA-ESI). Exploratory. No identification claim.

robots_txt.hadashot.iaa.org.il: User-agent: * Disallow: / (only named search-engine crawlers allowed). www.hadashot-esi.org.il and hadashot-esi.org.il redirect (301) to this host. Rule: no automated request to this host (no curl, no WebFetch). Reports that live only there are listed as 'unread, needs a person with a browser'.
robots_txt.publications.iaa.org.il: Disallows /do/, /fe-journals/ and named /cgi/*.cgi scripts (search, login, submit). Item pages, sitemaps and /cgi/viewcontent.cgi PDF downloads are allowed. Rule: at most one request per second; every file cached once in the scratch folder.

readable_corpus.where: https://publications.iaa.org.il/ha_hebrew_series/<n>/ (86 items; issue 44 absent; item 3 'HA 4-6' has no PDF but HA 4, 5, 6 exist as items 51-53)
readable_corpus.screen: Hebrew table of contents in the item description

readable_corpus.where: https://publications.iaa.org.il/esi_english_series/<n>/ (items 2-21; item 1 is an empty placeholder, item 13 a duplicate of HA 110 without PDF)
readable_corpus.screen: English table of contents in the item description; ESI 20 has no description, so its printed contents pages are screened from the PDF

readable_corpus.series: Hadashot Arkheologiyot - Excavations and Surveys in Israel 109-115 (bilingual print), 1999-2003
readable_corpus.where: https://publications.iaa.org.il/ha_esi_bilingual_series/<n>/ (items 1, 3-8; item 2 duplicate of 109 without PDF; item 9 = HA-ESI 116 has no PDF; item 10 duplicate of ESI 18 without PDF)
readable_corpus.screen: English table of contents in the item description
article titles from the issue listing page

unreadable_corpus.series: HA-ESI online reports, vols 116-137 (2004-2025), and any online-only report of earlier volumes
unreadable_corpus.rule: robots.txt disallows automated access. Candidate reports are enumerated only through a web search engine (WebSearch tool, allowed_domains hadashot.iaa.org.il and hadashot-esi.org.il), one query per query group below. Results (title, URL) go to candidates_unread.csv. They are not read, not coded, and not used as looks.

access.not_used: hadashot_gallery and ha-esi_slideshow (figure images); web.archive.org or any other copy of hadashot.iaa.org.il pages (would bypass the publisher's robots.txt); the owner's Drive copies (ESI 02-15 duplicate C2).

places.point_rule: distance is measured from the place's lat/lon in places_v2.csv
places.mixtures: jer_shaveh has no point; it is covered through its components jer_kidron_mon and jer_baqa. transjordan lies outside HA-ESI coverage (Jordan); it gets no screen and is reported as 'outside the source area', not as silence.

regions.rule: A report belongs to a region if its converted map reference falls inside the box, or, with no map reference, if its title names the region. Boxes are WGS84 and approximate (INFERENCE).

R_KIDRON.rule: title names the Kidron (kidron, qidron, wadi en-nar, nahal qidron, קדרון, ואדי א-נאר) or map ref within 2 km of jer_kidron_mon, jer_kidron_east, jer_gethsemane, jer_bir_ayyub or mar_saba

R_SILOAM_COD.rule: title names Siloam, Silwan, City of David, Ir David, Gihon or Ophel (or Hebrew equivalents), or map ref within 1 km of jer_siloam

R_JD_CLIFFS.rule: cliff and cave reports only: title matches R_JD_CLIFFS names above, and the report concerns caves, cliffs or a cave or desert survey

screen.unit: one table-of-contents item = one candidate report
screen.normalisation: Unicode NFKD, combining marks removed, lower case; the characters ʿ ʾ ‘ ’ ' ` ´ ׳ removed; hyphens, en dashes, commas, full stops and parentheses become spaces; spaces collapsed. Hebrew: niqqud removed, geresh and apostrophe kept as written in the pattern list after the same removal (patterns are normalised the same way).
screen.match: a pattern matches when it occurs in the normalised title with a word boundary (start, space) on its left and right. A title matching any place group or region is a candidate.
screen.duplicates: HA (Hebrew) and ESI (English) often print the same report. When both are candidates for the same site and season, the ESI or bilingual English text is read and the Hebrew item is listed in dropped.csv as a duplicate.
screen.known_limit: Reports whose titles name no listed place (for example a road survey named after a route number) are missed. This is recorded, not corrected after the fact.

location.map_ref: Take the report's own map reference. Old Israel Grid (OIG) values are converted with EPSG:28191 (Palestine 1923 / Palestine Grid, no 1000-km northing offset), exactly as W2B scripts/grid_convert.py oig(). New Israel Grid (NIG) values are converted with EPSG:2039 (Israel 1993 / Israeli TM Grid). Which grid: if the report labels it, use the label; otherwise northing in metres above 400000 = NIG, below 300000 = OIG. Digits: a 3-digit coordinate is in km, 4 digits in units of 100 m, 5 digits in units of 10 m, 6 digits in metres. Precision = that unit.
location.no_map_ref: If the report gives no map reference, the location is the place its title names; coordinate_source = 'name only'; distance stays null and the report counts at that place only.
location.distance: great-circle distance (R = 6371.0088 km) from the converted point to each place point in places_v2.csv
location.nearest_place: the place with the smallest distance (mixtures and transjordan excluded)
location.coverage_radius_for_looks: a report covers a place for looks_haesi.csv if distance <= max(sigma_km, 0.3) + map-ref precision in km

inclusion.reports_csv: every candidate report that was read (its text extracted and read)
inclusion.features_csv: only reports within 5 km of a place or inside a region box or rule; one row per (report, feature type); the row also notes how many such features the report states and which periods
inclusion.dropped_csv: every candidate not coded, with one reason: beyond 5 km and outside regions; duplicate; no PDF; not a field report (book notice, editorial); outside the source area; not read (time limit)

wall_tower.rule: walls inside an excavated building are not coded unless the report names a wall or tower as a feature in its own right (fortification, enclosure, terrace, field, dam or boundary wall)

coding.period_as_given: the report's own words for the feature's date

dated_in_window.yes: the report dates the feature itself to the Hasmonean, Herodian, Early Roman, Late Hellenistic (= Hasmonean), Second Temple or Bar Kokhba period, the 1st c. BCE, the 1st c. CE, or up to 135 CE; or says the feature was in use in that time
dated_in_window.no: the report dates the feature only outside the window (for example Iron Age, Byzantine, Early Islamic, Ottoman, Late Roman)
dated_in_window.unknown: undated, dated only by the site's general periods, or dated by a range that only partly overlaps the window (for example 'Hellenistic', 'Roman', 'Middle Roman', 'Hellenistic-Roman')

coding.excavated_or_surveyed: excavated / surveyed / inspected, from the report
coding.quote: verbatim, 12 words or fewer, from the report text (Hebrew stays Hebrew)
coding.relevance: which project entries (candidates_v2.csv) or open questions the row bears on; labelled EVIDENCE (what the report says) or INFERENCE (our link)
coding.protected_strip: a report that describes the strip from the north foot of Tell es-Sultan to about 250 m north is recorded with protected_strip = yes and a note that it is exposed text and not unseen evidence. No image of any kind is opened.

tiers.P1: Koḥlit proposals (tell_es_sultan, ein_samiya, kh_yanun, muhalhil, beit_kahil, kuhlah, carmel_siah, mount_zion, ein_ghuweir, ein_feshkha), iv17_abu_saraj, the Jericho group, the Qumran group, buqeia (Achor, Sekakah), gerizim, jer_siloam and the R_SILOAM_COD, R_WADI_QELT, R_JD_CLIFFS regions
tiers.P2: other places outside Jerusalem (mar_saba, hyrcania, natuf, tekoa_herodium, jordan_ford, beth_shean, ibziq, beth_horon, kh_salhab) and the R_KIDRON region

reading_order_and_stop_rule.rule: All candidates are located first (map reference extracted). Reading follows P1 to P4, oldest volume first within a tier. Whatever is not read when the session must end goes to dropped.csv as 'not read (time limit)' with its tier. Nothing is reordered after a result is seen.

looks_haesi.rows: one row per (report, place covered under location.coverage_radius_for_looks, entry for which candidates_v2.csv lists that place)
looks_haesi.required_feature: any HA-ESI coded feature type (cistern, pool or reservoir, channel or aqueduct, ritual bath, rock-cut installation, tomb or burial cave, cave with finds, wall or tower, hoard or cache) at the place
looks_haesi.result: reported if features.csv has at least one row for the report at that place; silent otherwise
looks_haesi.satisfies_requirement: unknown (the entry's own requirement is not judged here)
looks_haesi.numbers: coverage, p_recognise, p_report and p_survive stay null. If the report states an excavated area or depth, it is written in looked_at and the coverage basis says so; no fraction is invented.

tests: plan hash equals the README record
schemas of features.csv, reports.csv, dropped.csv, looks_haesi.csv
every quote has 12 words or fewer
every features row has a report id that exists in reports.csv
the summary script gives byte-identical output on two runs
